mary-the-holy-mother-of-god.name: Mary, the Holy Mother of God
mary-the-holy-mother-of-god.life_md:
On the first day of the year the Church honours Mary under her greatest title: Mother of God. The Council of Ephesus (431) proclaimed her *Theotokos*, "God-bearer", because the child she bore is truly God made man. Her quiet "yes" to the angel opened the way for our salvation, and she remains the model of faith for every disciple.

We begin each year under her care, asking her to bring us closer to her Son, the Prince of Peace.
mary-the-holy-mother-of-god.prayer_md:
Mary, the Holy Mother of God, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saints-basil-the-great-and-gregory-nazia.name: Saints Basil the Great and Gregory Nazianzen
saints-basil-the-great-and-gregory-nazia.life_md:
Basil and Gregory were close friends from their student days in Athens. Basil became Bishop of Caesarea in Cappadocia, wrote a rule that shaped Eastern monastic life and built a great centre of care for the poor and sick. Gregory, a gifted preacher and poet, served briefly as Bishop of Constantinople.

Together they defended the faith in the divinity of Christ and of the Holy Spirit against the Arian heresy, and both are honoured as Doctors of the Church.
saints-basil-the-great-and-gregory-nazia.prayer_md:
Saints Basil the Great and Gregory Nazianzen, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Basil the Great and Gregory Nazianzen to your Church as teachers of the true faith. Through their prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-raymond-of-penyafort.name: Saint Raymond of Penyafort
saint-raymond-of-penyafort.life_md:
Raymond was a brilliant teacher of law in Barcelona before joining the Dominicans. At the request of Pope Gregory IX he gathered the Church's laws into one great collection that was used for centuries. Elected Master General of the Dominicans, he resigned after two years to return to pastoral work, preaching and hearing confessions.

He encouraged the study of Arabic and Hebrew so that the Gospel could be shared with all peoples, and lived to almost a hundred.
saint-raymond-of-penyafort.prayer_md:
Saint Raymond of Penyafort, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Raymond of Penyafort to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-hilary-of-poitiers.name: Saint Hilary of Poitiers
saint-hilary-of-poitiers.life_md:
Hilary was a married man who came to faith through reading the Scriptures and was later chosen Bishop of Poitiers in France. He courageously defended the divinity of Christ against the Arian emperors and was exiled for it to Asia Minor, where he wrote his great work *On the Trinity*.

His clear teaching earned him the title "Athanasius of the West", and he is honoured as a Doctor of the Church.
saint-hilary-of-poitiers.prayer_md:
Saint Hilary of Poitiers, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Hilary of Poitiers to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-anthony-of-egypt.name: Saint Anthony of Egypt
saint-anthony-of-egypt.life_md:
Hearing the Gospel words "Go, sell what you have and give to the poor," the young Anthony did exactly that and went into the Egyptian desert to live for God alone. For decades he prayed, fasted and battled temptation. Many disciples gathered around him, and he became known as the father of monasticism.

Saint Athanasius wrote his life, which inspired countless men and women to give themselves wholly to God.
saint-anthony-of-egypt.prayer_md:
Saint Anthony of Egypt, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Anthony of Egypt to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-fabian.name: Saint Fabian
saint-fabian.life_md:
Fabian was a layman visiting Rome when, according to tradition, a dove settled on his head during the papal election, and the people acclaimed him pope. He governed the Church wisely for fourteen years, organising Rome into districts for the care of the poor.

He was among the first to die in the persecution of Emperor Decius in 250.
saint-fabian.prayer_md:
Saint Fabian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Fabian to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-sebastian.name: Saint Sebastian
saint-sebastian.life_md:
Sebastian was a Christian officer in the Roman army who used his position to encourage believers in prison. When his faith was discovered he was shot with arrows and left for dead. Nursed back to health, he boldly confronted the emperor again and was beaten to death.

He has long been honoured as a model of courage and loyalty to Christ.
saint-sebastian.prayer_md:
Saint Sebastian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Sebastian to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-agnes.name: Saint Agnes
saint-agnes.life_md:
Agnes was only about twelve or thirteen when she refused marriage, saying she had already given herself to Christ. Denounced as a Christian, she faced threats and torture with astonishing calm and was put to death in Rome.

Her name is remembered in the Roman Canon of the Mass, and lambs blessed on her feast provide wool for the pallium worn by archbishops.
saint-agnes.prayer_md:
Saint Agnes, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Agnes to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through her prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-vincent-of-saragossa.name: Saint Vincent of Saragossa
saint-vincent-of-saragossa.life_md:
Vincent served as deacon to Bishop Valerius of Saragossa in Spain, preaching on the bishop's behalf. During the persecution of Diocletian he was arrested and cruelly tortured, yet remained joyful and firm in the faith until he died.

He is the most celebrated martyr of Spain.
saint-vincent-of-saragossa.prayer_md:
Saint Vincent of Saragossa, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Vincent of Saragossa to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-francis-de-sales.name: Saint Francis de Sales
saint-francis-de-sales.life_md:
Francis gave up a promising legal career to become a priest. Sent to the Chablais region, he won thousands back to the Catholic faith through patience and gentle preaching, even slipping leaflets under doors. As Bishop of Geneva he wrote *Introduction to the Devout Life*, teaching that holiness is possible for everyone in every walk of life.

With Saint Jane Frances de Chantal he founded the Visitation Sisters. He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-francis-de-sales.prayer_md:
Saint Francis de Sales, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Francis de Sales to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-conversion-of-saint-paul.name: The Conversion of Saint Paul
the-conversion-of-saint-paul.life_md:
Saul of Tarsus was a zealous persecutor of the first Christians until, on the road to Damascus, the risen Jesus appeared to him and asked, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?" Blinded, then healed and baptised, he became Paul, the great Apostle to the Gentiles.

His conversion shows that no one is beyond the reach of God's grace.
the-conversion-of-saint-paul.prayer_md:
The Conversion of Saint Paul, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Conversion of Saint Paul to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-timothy-and-titus.name: Saints Timothy and Titus
saints-timothy-and-titus.life_md:
Timothy and Titus were trusted companions and co-workers of Saint Paul. Timothy, whose mother and grandmother taught him the faith, became leader of the Church in Ephesus; Titus was entrusted with the Church in Crete. Paul wrote letters to both, full of guidance on caring for God's people.

They remind us that the Gospel is handed on from generation to generation.
saints-timothy-and-titus.prayer_md:
Saints Timothy and Titus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Timothy and Titus to your Church as shepherds of your people. Through their prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-angela-merici.name: Saint Angela Merici
saint-angela-merici.life_md:
Angela was convinced that strong Christian families needed well-formed women. In Brescia she gathered a group of young women who lived consecrated lives in their own homes while teaching girls the faith.

In 1535 she founded the Company of Saint Ursula, the Ursulines, the first order of women dedicated to education.
saint-angela-merici.prayer_md:
Saint Angela Merici, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-thomas-aquinas.name: Saint Thomas Aquinas
saint-thomas-aquinas.life_md:
Thomas joined the Dominicans against his family's wishes. A quiet student nicknamed "the dumb ox", he became one of the greatest minds in history. His *Summa Theologiae* shows how faith and reason work together. He also wrote beautiful hymns for the Eucharist, such as *Pange Lingua*.

Near the end of his life he said that all he had written seemed like straw compared with what God had shown him. He is the "Angelic Doctor".
saint-thomas-aquinas.prayer_md:
Saint Thomas Aquinas, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Thomas Aquinas to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-bosco.name: Saint John Bosco
saint-john-bosco.life_md:
Don Bosco gave his life to the poor and abandoned boys of industrial Turin. He offered them shelter, schooling, trades and, above all, the love of Christ, using a method of reason, religion and kindness. To continue the work he founded the Salesians and, with Saint Mary Mazzarello, the Salesian Sisters.

Today his family serves young people in more than 130 countries.
saint-john-bosco.prayer_md:
Saint John Bosco, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Bosco to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-ansgar.name: Saint Ansgar
saint-ansgar.life_md:
Ansgar was a Benedictine monk who answered the call to bring the Gospel to Denmark and Sweden. As Archbishop of Hamburg he persevered through many setbacks, including the burning of his city.

He is called the Apostle of the North.
saint-ansgar.prayer_md:
Saint Ansgar, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Ansgar to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-blase.name: Saint Blase
saint-blase.life_md:
Blase was a bishop in Sebaste, Armenia, martyred in the early fourth century. Tradition tells that he saved a boy who was choking on a fish bone.

On his feast many parishes bless throats with two crossed candles, praying for protection from illness.
saint-blase.prayer_md:
Saint Blase, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Blase to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-agatha.name: Saint Agatha
saint-agatha.life_md:
Agatha was a young Christian woman of Sicily who consecrated her life to God. When she refused the advances of a Roman official, he had her tortured and imprisoned, and she died a martyr.

She is named in the Roman Canon of the Mass.
saint-agatha.prayer_md:
Saint Agatha, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Agatha to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through her prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-paul-miki-and-companions.name: Saints Paul Miki and Companions
saints-paul-miki-and-companions.life_md:
Paul Miki was a Japanese Jesuit and a powerful preacher. In 1597, during a persecution, he and twenty-five companions, priests, brothers, catechists and boys among them, were marched to Nagasaki and crucified.

From his cross Paul forgave his persecutors. Japanese Christians kept the faith in secret for over two centuries after them.
saints-paul-miki-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saints Paul Miki and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Paul Miki and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-jerome-emiliani.name: Saint Jerome Emiliani
saint-jerome-emiliani.life_md:
Jerome was a Venetian soldier who, after being captured in war, gave his life to God. Moved by the suffering caused by famine and plague, he cared for orphans, the homeless and the sick, and founded the Somascan Fathers.

He died caring for plague victims.
saint-jerome-emiliani.prayer_md:
Saint Jerome Emiliani, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Jerome Emiliani to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-josephine-bakhita.name: Saint Josephine Bakhita
saint-josephine-bakhita.life_md:
Kidnapped as a child in Sudan and sold into slavery, Bakhita suffered terrible cruelty. Brought to Italy, she came to know Christ through the Canossian Sisters, was baptised and won her freedom. She joined the sisters and served humbly as cook and doorkeeper, known for her gentleness.

She said she would even thank her kidnappers, because without them she would not have known God. She is a patron of those who suffer trafficking today.
saint-josephine-bakhita.prayer_md:
Saint Josephine Bakhita, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Josephine Bakhita to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-scholastica.name: Saint Scholastica
saint-scholastica.life_md:
Scholastica was the twin sister of Saint Benedict and led a community of nuns near his monastery. The siblings met once a year to talk about God. At their last meeting she prayed for him to stay longer, and a sudden storm kept him there all night.

She died three days later, and Benedict saw her soul rise to heaven like a dove.
saint-scholastica.prayer_md:
Saint Scholastica, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Scholastica to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-lourdes.name: Our Lady of Lourdes
our-lady-of-lourdes.life_md:
In 1858 the Virgin Mary appeared eighteen times to Bernadette Soubirous, a poor girl of Lourdes in France. She called people to prayer and penance and named herself "the Immaculate Conception". A spring revealed at the grotto has been linked with many healings.

This day is also the World Day of the Sick, when the Church prays for all who suffer.
our-lady-of-lourdes.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saints-cyril-and-methodius.name: Saints Cyril and Methodius
saints-cyril-and-methodius.life_md:
The brothers Cyril and Methodius were Greek missionaries to the Slavic peoples. They created an alphabet for the Slavonic language so that the Scriptures and the liturgy could be shared in the people's own tongue.

They are honoured as Apostles of the Slavs and patrons of Europe.
saints-cyril-and-methodius.prayer_md:
Saints Cyril and Methodius, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Cyril and Methodius to your Church as shepherds of your people. Through their prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-seven-holy-founders-of-the-servites.name: The Seven Holy Founders of the Servites
the-seven-holy-founders-of-the-servites.life_md:
Seven merchants of Florence left their businesses in the 13th century to live a life of prayer and penance together, devoted to the Virgin Mary.

Their community became the Order of Servants of Mary, the Servites, known especially for devotion to Our Lady of Sorrows.
the-seven-holy-founders-of-the-servites.prayer_md:
The Seven Holy Founders of the Servites, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Seven Holy Founders of the Servites to your Church as models of prayer and holiness. Through their prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-peter-damian.name: Saint Peter Damian
saint-peter-damian.life_md:
Orphaned young, Peter Damian became a monk and a great reformer of the Church. He fought corruption among clergy, encouraged prayer and penance, and was made a cardinal.

His writings on the spiritual life earned him the title Doctor of the Church.
saint-peter-damian.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Damian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Damian to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-chair-of-saint-peter.name: The Chair of Saint Peter
the-chair-of-saint-peter.life_md:
Today the Church celebrates the mission Christ gave to Peter: "You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my Church." The "chair" is a sign of the authority to teach and to shepherd.

We give thanks for the gift of the Pope and pray for him as the successor of Peter.
the-chair-of-saint-peter.prayer_md:
The Chair of Saint Peter, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Chair of Saint Peter to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-polycarp.name: Saint Polycarp
saint-polycarp.life_md:
Polycarp was a disciple of Saint John the Apostle and Bishop of Smyrna for many years. Arrested in old age and told to curse Christ, he replied: "Eighty-six years I have served him, and he has done me no wrong. How can I blaspheme my King who saved me?"

He was burned and stabbed to death, one of the first martyrs whose death was recorded.
saint-polycarp.prayer_md:
Saint Polycarp, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Polycarp to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-gregory-of-narek.name: Saint Gregory of Narek
saint-gregory-of-narek.life_md:
Gregory was an Armenian monk, poet and mystic. His *Book of Lamentations*, a series of heartfelt prayers to God from the depths of the soul, is treasured by Armenian Christians.

Pope Francis named him a Doctor of the Church in 2015.
saint-gregory-of-narek.prayer_md:
Saint Gregory of Narek, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Gregory of Narek to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-casimir.name: Saint Casimir
saint-casimir.life_md:
Casimir was a prince of Poland who preferred prayer to the life of court. He lived simply, loved the poor and was deeply devoted to the Blessed Virgin Mary.

He died of tuberculosis at twenty-five.
saint-casimir.prayer_md:
Saint Casimir, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Casimir to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-perpetua-and-felicity.name: Saints Perpetua and Felicity
saints-perpetua-and-felicity.life_md:
Perpetua, a young noblewoman and new mother, and Felicity, a slave who gave birth in prison, were catechumens in Carthage in North Africa. Refusing to deny Christ, they were put to death in the arena with their companions.

Perpetua's own prison diary tells their story. They are named in the Roman Canon.
saints-perpetua-and-felicity.prayer_md:
Saints Perpetua and Felicity, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Perpetua and Felicity to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-of-god.name: Saint John of God
saint-john-of-god.life_md:
After a restless life as a soldier and shepherd, John was moved by a sermon to give everything to God. He began caring for the sick and poor in Granada, carrying them on his back to his small hospital.

His followers became the Brothers Hospitallers, who still serve the sick worldwide.
saint-john-of-god.prayer_md:
Saint John of God, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John of God to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-frances-of-rome.name: Saint Frances of Rome
saint-frances-of-rome.life_md:
Frances was a wife and mother in a noble Roman family who cared tirelessly for the poor and sick, especially during plague and war. She said, "A married woman must sometimes leave God at the altar to find him in her household care."

After her husband's death she joined the community of women she had founded.
saint-frances-of-rome.prayer_md:
Saint Frances of Rome, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Frances of Rome to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-patrick.name: Saint Patrick
saint-patrick.life_md:
Kidnapped from Britain as a teenager and enslaved in Ireland, Patrick turned to God in prayer. He escaped, became a priest and returned as a missionary bishop to the people who had enslaved him.

His preaching brought the faith to all of Ireland. Tradition says he used the shamrock to explain the Holy Trinity.
saint-patrick.prayer_md:
Saint Patrick, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Patrick to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-cyril-of-jerusalem.name: Saint Cyril of Jerusalem
saint-cyril-of-jerusalem.life_md:
Cyril was Bishop of Jerusalem and was exiled three times during the Arian controversies. His *Catecheses*, talks given to those preparing for Baptism, are a treasure of early teaching on the sacraments and the Eucharist.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-cyril-of-jerusalem.prayer_md:
Saint Cyril of Jerusalem, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Cyril of Jerusalem to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-joseph-spouse-of-the-blessed-virgi.name: Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saint-joseph-spouse-of-the-blessed-virgi.life_md:
Joseph, a just man of the house of David, was chosen by God to be husband of Mary and guardian of Jesus. Without speaking a single recorded word in the Gospels, he obeyed God promptly, protecting the Holy Family through danger and exile and teaching Jesus his trade as a carpenter.

He is patron of the universal Church, of fathers and of workers, and of a happy death.
saint-joseph-spouse-of-the-blessed-virgi.prayer_md:
Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-turibius-of-mogrovejo.name: Saint Turibius of Mogrovejo
saint-turibius-of-mogrovejo.life_md:
Turibius was a Spanish lawyer, not yet a priest, when he was appointed Archbishop of Lima in Peru. He travelled tens of thousands of kilometres to visit his people, learned local languages, defended the native peoples against abuse and founded the first seminary in the Americas.

He confirmed Saint Rose of Lima and Saint Martin de Porres.
saint-turibius-of-mogrovejo.prayer_md:
Saint Turibius of Mogrovejo, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Turibius of Mogrovejo to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-francis-of-paola.name: Saint Francis of Paola
saint-francis-of-paola.life_md:
Francis lived as a hermit from his teens and drew many followers by his holiness. He founded the Minim Friars, who lived in great humility and perpetual fasting.

Known for miracles, he was called to France to attend the dying King Louis XI and spent his last years there.
saint-francis-of-paola.prayer_md:
Saint Francis of Paola, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Francis of Paola to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-isidore-of-seville.name: Saint Isidore of Seville
saint-isidore-of-seville.life_md:
Isidore succeeded his brother as Archbishop of Seville. A great scholar, he wrote an encyclopaedia, the *Etymologies*, that preserved learning for centuries, and worked for the unity and education of the Church in Spain.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-isidore-of-seville.prayer_md:
Saint Isidore of Seville, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Isidore of Seville to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-vincent-ferrer.name: Saint Vincent Ferrer
saint-vincent-ferrer.life_md:
Vincent was a Dominican preacher who travelled across Europe calling people to repentance. Crowds of thousands followed him, and many conversions and miracles were reported.

He also worked to heal the Great Western Schism that divided the Church.
saint-vincent-ferrer.prayer_md:
Saint Vincent Ferrer, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Vincent Ferrer to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-baptist-de-la-salle.name: Saint John Baptist de la Salle
saint-john-baptist-de-la-salle.life_md:
A wealthy priest of Reims, John Baptist gave up his fortune to provide free education for poor children. He trained teachers and founded the Brothers of the Christian Schools, pioneering teaching methods still used today.

He is patron of teachers.
saint-john-baptist-de-la-salle.prayer_md:
Saint John Baptist de la Salle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Baptist de la Salle to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-stanislaus.name: Saint Stanislaus
saint-stanislaus.life_md:
Stanislaus was Bishop of Kraków who fearlessly rebuked King Bolesław II for his cruelty and immorality. The king had him killed while he was celebrating Mass.

He is a patron of Poland.
saint-stanislaus.prayer_md:
Saint Stanislaus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Stanislaus to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-martin-i.name: Saint Martin I
saint-martin-i.life_md:
Pope Martin I defended the teaching that Christ has both a human and a divine will. For this the emperor had him arrested, dragged to Constantinople, humiliated and exiled to the Crimea, where he died of hardship.

He is the last pope venerated as a martyr.
saint-martin-i.prayer_md:
Saint Martin I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Martin I to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-anselm-of-canterbury.name: Saint Anselm of Canterbury
saint-anselm-of-canterbury.life_md:
Anselm was a Benedictine abbot and later Archbishop of Canterbury who defended the freedom of the Church against the English kings. His motto, "faith seeking understanding", shaped Christian thought.

He is called the father of scholasticism and is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-anselm-of-canterbury.prayer_md:
Saint Anselm of Canterbury, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Anselm of Canterbury to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-adalbert-of-prague.name: Saint Adalbert of Prague
saint-adalbert-of-prague.life_md: Adalbert was Bishop of Prague who worked to reform his diocese and later became a missionary. He was martyred while preaching to the pagan Prussians on the Baltic coast.
saint-adalbert-of-prague.prayer_md:
Saint Adalbert of Prague, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Adalbert of Prague to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-george.name: Saint George
saint-george.life_md:
George was a soldier martyred in Palestine during the persecution of Diocletian. The famous legend of George slaying the dragon pictures the victory of faith over evil.

He is honoured by Christians in East and West alike.
saint-george.prayer_md:
Saint George, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint George to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-fidelis-of-sigmaringen.name: Saint Fidelis of Sigmaringen
saint-fidelis-of-sigmaringen.life_md: Fidelis was a lawyer known as "the poor man's lawyer" before becoming a Capuchin friar. Sent to preach in Switzerland, he was killed by opponents of the Catholic faith.
saint-fidelis-of-sigmaringen.prayer_md:
Saint Fidelis of Sigmaringen, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Fidelis of Sigmaringen to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-mark-the-evangelist.name: Saint Mark the Evangelist
saint-mark-the-evangelist.life_md:
Mark, also called John Mark, travelled with Saints Paul and Barnabas and later with Saint Peter, whose preaching shaped his Gospel, the shortest of the four. His Gospel begins, "The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God."

Tradition says he founded the Church in Alexandria, Egypt. His symbol is the lion.
saint-mark-the-evangelist.prayer_md:
Saint Mark the Evangelist, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-louis-marie-grignion-de-montfort.name: Saint Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort
saint-louis-marie-grignion-de-montfort.life_md: Louis preached missions across western France with great zeal. His book *True Devotion to Mary* teaches total consecration to Jesus through Mary, a devotion embraced by many, including Saint John Paul II.
saint-louis-marie-grignion-de-montfort.prayer_md:
Saint Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-peter-chanel.name: Saint Peter Chanel
saint-peter-chanel.life_md:
Peter Chanel was a Marist missionary who went to the island of Futuna in the Pacific. He was killed there, but within a few years the whole island had become Christian.

He is the first martyr of Oceania.
saint-peter-chanel.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Chanel, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Chanel to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-catherine-of-siena.name: Saint Catherine of Siena
saint-catherine-of-siena.life_md:
Catherine was the 24th child of a family of Siena. A Dominican tertiary, she cared for the sick and the poor and lived a deep life of prayer. Fearless and full of love for the Church, she persuaded the Pope to return from Avignon to Rome. Her *Dialogue* records her conversations with God.

She is a Doctor of the Church and patron of Europe.
saint-catherine-of-siena.prayer_md:
Saint Catherine of Siena, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Catherine of Siena to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through her prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-pius-v.name: Saint Pius V
saint-pius-v.life_md:
Pius V was a Dominican friar who became pope after the Council of Trent and put its reforms into action, publishing the Roman Catechism and the Roman Missal.

He asked all Christians to pray the Rosary before the Battle of Lepanto in 1571.
saint-pius-v.prayer_md:
Saint Pius V, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Pius V to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-joseph-the-worker.name: Saint Joseph the Worker
saint-joseph-the-worker.life_md:
Pope Pius XII set this feast in 1955 to honour the dignity of human work. Joseph, the carpenter of Nazareth, earned his family's bread with his hands, and Jesus shared that work.

We pray for all workers and for those seeking work.
saint-joseph-the-worker.prayer_md:
Saint Joseph the Worker, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Joseph the Worker to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-athanasius.name: Saint Athanasius
saint-athanasius.life_md:
Athanasius was Bishop of Alexandria and the great defender of the faith of the Council of Nicaea that Jesus is truly God. He was exiled five times for refusing to give way to the Arians.

An African Father of the Church, he wrote the *Life of Anthony* and is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-athanasius.prayer_md:
Saint Athanasius, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Athanasius to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-philip-and-james-apostles.name: Saints Philip and James, Apostles
saints-philip-and-james-apostles.life_md:
Philip, from Bethsaida, brought Nathanael to Jesus and asked at the Last Supper, "Lord, show us the Father." James, son of Alphaeus, often called "the Less", is traditionally identified as the leader of the Church in Jerusalem and author of the Letter of James.

Both gave their lives as witnesses to Christ.
saints-philip-and-james-apostles.prayer_md:
Saints Philip and James, Apostles, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Philip and James, Apostles to your Church as apostles of the Good News. Through their prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-of-avila.name: Saint John of Avila
saint-john-of-avila.life_md:
John of Avila was a great preacher in southern Spain and a spiritual guide to many saints, including Teresa of Avila and John of God. He worked for the renewal of the clergy.

He was named a Doctor of the Church in 2012.
saint-john-of-avila.prayer_md:
Saint John of Avila, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John of Avila to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-pancras.name: Saint Pancras
saint-pancras.life_md: Pancras was a boy of about fourteen who was beheaded in Rome for his faith during the persecution of Diocletian.
saint-pancras.prayer_md:
Saint Pancras, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Pancras to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-nereus-and-achilleus.name: Saints Nereus and Achilleus
saints-nereus-and-achilleus.life_md: Nereus and Achilleus were Roman soldiers who became Christians, left the army and were martyred. Pope Damasus wrote an inscription for their tomb.
saints-nereus-and-achilleus.prayer_md:
Saints Nereus and Achilleus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Nereus and Achilleus to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-fatima.name: Our Lady of Fatima
our-lady-of-fatima.life_md:
In 1917 the Virgin Mary appeared six times to three shepherd children, Lucia, Francisco and Jacinta, at Fatima in Portugal. She asked for prayer, especially the daily Rosary, penance and conversion for peace in the world.

The apparitions ended with the "miracle of the sun" witnessed by thousands.
our-lady-of-fatima.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-matthias-the-apostle.name: Saint Matthias the Apostle
saint-matthias-the-apostle.life_md:
After the betrayal and death of Judas, the apostles prayed and cast lots, and Matthias was chosen to complete the Twelve. He had followed Jesus from his baptism to the Resurrection.

Tradition says he preached and was martyred for the faith.
saint-matthias-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint Matthias the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Matthias the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-i.name: Saint John I
saint-john-i.life_md: Pope John I was sent by the Arian king Theodoric to Constantinople. On his return the king, suspicious of him, imprisoned him at Ravenna, where he died of hardship.
saint-john-i.prayer_md:
Saint John I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John I to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bernardine-of-siena.name: Saint Bernardine of Siena
saint-bernardine-of-siena.life_md: Bernardine was a Franciscan preacher who travelled throughout Italy calling people to conversion. He spread devotion to the Holy Name of Jesus, showing the letters IHS on a tablet.
saint-bernardine-of-siena.prayer_md:
Saint Bernardine of Siena, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bernardine of Siena to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-christopher-magallanes-and-compani.name: Saint Christopher Magallanes and Companions
saint-christopher-magallanes-and-compani.life_md: Christopher Magallanes was a Mexican priest killed with many companions during the persecution of the Church in Mexico in the 1920s. Before being shot he forgave his executioners.
saint-christopher-magallanes-and-compani.prayer_md:
Saint Christopher Magallanes and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Christopher Magallanes and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-rita-of-cascia.name: Saint Rita of Cascia
saint-rita-of-cascia.life_md:
Rita endured a difficult marriage with patience until her husband was converted and later killed. After the deaths of her sons she entered the Augustinian convent at Cascia, where she lived in prayer.

She is invoked as patron of impossible causes.
saint-rita-of-cascia.prayer_md:
Saint Rita of Cascia, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Rita of Cascia to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bede-the-venerable.name: Saint Bede the Venerable
saint-bede-the-venerable.life_md:
Bede spent almost his whole life in the monastery of Jarrow in England, praying, studying and teaching. His *Ecclesiastical History of the English People* earned him the title father of English history.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-bede-the-venerable.prayer_md:
Saint Bede the Venerable, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bede the Venerable to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-gregory-vii.name: Saint Gregory VII
saint-gregory-vii.life_md: Gregory VII was a great reforming pope who fought corruption in the Church and defended its freedom from control by kings and emperors. He died in exile, saying: "I have loved justice and hated iniquity."
saint-gregory-vii.prayer_md:
Saint Gregory VII, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Gregory VII to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-mary-magdalene-de-pazzi.name: Saint Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi
saint-mary-magdalene-de-pazzi.life_md: A Carmelite nun of Florence, Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi had deep mystical experiences and bore long trials with patience. She is remembered for her love for the Church and prayer for its renewal.
saint-mary-magdalene-de-pazzi.prayer_md:
Saint Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-philip-neri.name: Saint Philip Neri
saint-philip-neri.life_md:
Philip Neri, the "Apostle of Rome", drew people of all ages to God through his warmth, humour and joy. He founded the Congregation of the Oratory, whose gatherings combined prayer, Scripture, music and conversation.

He taught that cheerfulness strengthens the heart.
saint-philip-neri.prayer_md:
Saint Philip Neri, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Philip Neri to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-augustine-of-canterbury.name: Saint Augustine of Canterbury
saint-augustine-of-canterbury.life_md: Augustine was a monk sent by Pope Gregory the Great to bring the Gospel to the English. He baptised King Ethelbert of Kent and became the first Archbishop of Canterbury.
saint-augustine-of-canterbury.prayer_md:
Saint Augustine of Canterbury, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Augustine of Canterbury to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-paul-vi.name: Saint Paul VI
saint-paul-vi.life_md:
Giovanni Battista Montini guided the Second Vatican Council to its conclusion and carried out its reforms. He was the first pope to travel widely, including a visit to Uganda in 1969, the first by a pope to Africa. His encyclical *Humanae Vitae* defended the dignity of human life and love.

He was canonised in 2018.
saint-paul-vi.prayer_md:
Saint Paul VI, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Paul VI to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-visitation-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.name: The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-visitation-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.life_md:
After the Annunciation, Mary hurried to visit her cousin Elizabeth. The child in Elizabeth's womb, John the Baptist, leapt for joy, and Elizabeth greeted her: "Blessed are you among women." Mary replied with her song of praise, the *Magnificat*.

The feast celebrates Mary bringing Christ to others in loving service.
the-visitation-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.prayer_md:
The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-justin-martyr.name: Saint Justin Martyr
saint-justin-martyr.life_md:
Justin was a philosopher who searched for truth in many schools until he found it in Christ. He wrote defences of the faith and the earliest description of the Mass on Sunday.

He was beheaded in Rome for refusing to sacrifice to the gods.
saint-justin-martyr.prayer_md:
Saint Justin Martyr, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Justin Martyr to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-marcellinus-and-peter.name: Saints Marcellinus and Peter
saints-marcellinus-and-peter.life_md: Marcellinus, a priest, and Peter, an exorcist, were martyred in Rome during the persecution of Diocletian. They are named in the Roman Canon.
saints-marcellinus-and-peter.prayer_md:
Saints Marcellinus and Peter, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Marcellinus and Peter to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-charles-lwanga-and-companions.name: Saints Charles Lwanga and Companions
saints-charles-lwanga-and-companions.life_md:
Charles Lwanga was head of the royal pages at the court of King Mwanga of Buganda in today's Uganda. When the king demanded that the young Christian pages give up their faith and submit to his immoral wishes, Charles protected and encouraged them.

With twenty-one Catholic companions, many still in their teens, he was burned alive at Namugongo in 1886. Anglican martyrs died with them. Their witness sparked the rapid growth of the Church in Uganda and across Africa.
saints-charles-lwanga-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saints Charles Lwanga and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Charles Lwanga and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-boniface.name: Saint Boniface
saint-boniface.life_md:
Boniface was an English monk who became the great missionary to the Germans. He organised the Church there and famously felled the sacred oak of Thor to show the power of the true God.

He was martyred in Frisia with his companions.
saint-boniface.prayer_md:
Saint Boniface, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Boniface to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-norbert.name: Saint Norbert
saint-norbert.life_md: After a worldly youth, Norbert experienced a dramatic conversion and became a priest and preacher. He founded the Premonstratensians, or Norbertines, and later became Archbishop of Magdeburg.
saint-norbert.prayer_md:
Saint Norbert, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Norbert to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-ephrem-the-syrian.name: Saint Ephrem the Syrian
saint-ephrem-the-syrian.life_md:
Ephrem was a deacon in Syria who wrote hundreds of hymns teaching the faith, earning the name "Harp of the Holy Spirit". He cared for the hungry during famine.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-ephrem-the-syrian.prayer_md:
Saint Ephrem the Syrian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Ephrem the Syrian to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-barnabas-the-apostle.name: Saint Barnabas the Apostle
saint-barnabas-the-apostle.life_md:
Barnabas, whose name means "son of encouragement", sold his field and gave the money to the apostles. He welcomed Saul after his conversion and travelled with him on his first missionary journey.

Tradition says he was martyred in Cyprus.
saint-barnabas-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint Barnabas the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Barnabas the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-anthony-of-padua.name: Saint Anthony of Padua
saint-anthony-of-padua.life_md:
Born in Lisbon, Anthony joined the Franciscans hoping to be a missionary in Morocco. Illness changed his plans, and in Italy his gift for preaching was discovered. His sermons converted many.

He died young and is one of the most loved saints, invoked to find lost things. He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-anthony-of-padua.prayer_md:
Saint Anthony of Padua, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Anthony of Padua to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-romuald.name: Saint Romuald
saint-romuald.life_md: Romuald was a monk who founded the Camaldolese order, combining community life with the solitude of hermits. He spent his life renewing monasteries.
saint-romuald.prayer_md:
Saint Romuald, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Romuald to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-aloysius-gonzaga.name: Saint Aloysius Gonzaga
saint-aloysius-gonzaga.life_md:
Aloysius gave up his inheritance as heir of a noble family to join the Jesuits. During a plague in Rome he cared for the sick, carrying them to hospital, and caught the disease himself. He died at twenty-three.

He is patron of young people.
saint-aloysius-gonzaga.prayer_md:
Saint Aloysius Gonzaga, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Aloysius Gonzaga to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-paulinus-of-nola.name: Saint Paulinus of Nola
saint-paulinus-of-nola.life_md: Paulinus was a wealthy Roman senator and poet who, with his wife Therasia, gave away his riches to the poor. He became Bishop of Nola in Italy and was known for his charity.
saint-paulinus-of-nola.prayer_md:
Saint Paulinus of Nola, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Paulinus of Nola to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-john-fisher-and-thomas-more.name: Saints John Fisher and Thomas More
saints-john-fisher-and-thomas-more.life_md:
John Fisher, Bishop of Rochester, and Thomas More, Lord Chancellor of England, refused to accept King Henry VIII as head of the Church in England. Both were beheaded in 1535.

More declared on the scaffold: "I die the king's good servant, but God's first."
saints-john-fisher-and-thomas-more.prayer_md:
Saints John Fisher and Thomas More, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints John Fisher and Thomas More to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-nativity-of-saint-john-the-baptist.name: The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist
the-nativity-of-saint-john-the-baptist.life_md:
John the Baptist is the only saint, besides Our Lady, whose birth is celebrated as a solemnity. Born to the elderly Elizabeth and Zechariah, he was sent to prepare the way for the Lord.

He pointed to Jesus, saying: "Behold the Lamb of God," and "He must increase, I must decrease."
the-nativity-of-saint-john-the-baptist.prayer_md:
The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-cyril-of-alexandria.name: Saint Cyril of Alexandria
saint-cyril-of-alexandria.life_md:
Cyril was Bishop of Alexandria and defended at the Council of Ephesus (431) the truth that Mary is the Mother of God, because Jesus is one divine Person.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-cyril-of-alexandria.prayer_md:
Saint Cyril of Alexandria, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Cyril of Alexandria to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-irenaeus.name: Saint Irenaeus
saint-irenaeus.life_md:
Irenaeus learned the faith from Saint Polycarp and became Bishop of Lyon in France. His work *Against Heresies* defended the faith handed down from the apostles. He wrote: "The glory of God is man fully alive."

Pope Francis named him a Doctor of the Church.
saint-irenaeus.prayer_md:
Saint Irenaeus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Irenaeus to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-peter-and-paul-apostles.name: Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles
saints-peter-and-paul-apostles.life_md:
Peter, the fisherman chosen by Jesus as the rock on which he built his Church, and Paul, the persecutor who became the Apostle to the Gentiles, both gave their lives in Rome. Peter was crucified and Paul beheaded.

Together they are the pillars of the Church.
saints-peter-and-paul-apostles.prayer_md:
Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles to your Church as apostles of the Good News. Through their prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-first-martyrs-of-the-church-of-rome.name: The First Martyrs of the Church of Rome
the-first-martyrs-of-the-church-of-rome.life_md:
After the great fire of Rome in 64, Emperor Nero blamed the Christians. Many were cruelly put to death in the city.

The Church honours these unnamed first martyrs the day after Saints Peter and Paul.
the-first-martyrs-of-the-church-of-rome.prayer_md:
The First Martyrs of the Church of Rome, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The First Martyrs of the Church of Rome to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-thomas-the-apostle.name: Saint Thomas the Apostle
saint-thomas-the-apostle.life_md:
Thomas, called the Twin, doubted the Resurrection until the risen Jesus showed him his wounds. Then he made the great profession of faith: "My Lord and my God!"

Tradition holds that he took the Gospel to India, where he was martyred.
saint-thomas-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint Thomas the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Thomas the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-elizabeth-of-portugal.name: Saint Elizabeth of Portugal
saint-elizabeth-of-portugal.life_md:
Elizabeth, a princess of Aragon, became Queen of Portugal. She bore an unfaithful husband with patience, served the poor and more than once made peace between warring members of her family.

After her husband's death she lived as a Franciscan tertiary.
saint-elizabeth-of-portugal.prayer_md:
Saint Elizabeth of Portugal, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Elizabeth of Portugal to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-anthony-mary-zaccaria.name: Saint Anthony Mary Zaccaria
saint-anthony-mary-zaccaria.life_md: Anthony was a doctor who became a priest and worked to renew the faith in Milan. He founded the Barnabites and spread devotion to the Eucharist and to the letters of Saint Paul. He died at thirty-six.
saint-anthony-mary-zaccaria.prayer_md:
Saint Anthony Mary Zaccaria, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Anthony Mary Zaccaria to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-maria-goretti.name: Saint Maria Goretti
saint-maria-goretti.life_md:
Maria was an eleven-year-old Italian girl who resisted an attack on her purity and was stabbed. Before dying she forgave her attacker, Alessandro.

Years later he repented and was present at her canonisation in 1950.
saint-maria-goretti.prayer_md:
Saint Maria Goretti, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Maria Goretti to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through her prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-augustine-zhao-rong-and-companions.name: Saint Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions
saint-augustine-zhao-rong-and-companions.life_md:
Augustine Zhao Rong was a Chinese soldier who, moved by the patience of a martyred bishop, became a Christian and then a priest. He died in prison in 1815.

He is honoured with 119 other martyrs of China, Chinese and foreign, who died between 1648 and 1930.
saint-augustine-zhao-rong-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saint Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-benedict.name: Saint Benedict
saint-benedict.life_md:
Benedict left the city of Rome to seek God in solitude. Disciples gathered around him, and at Monte Cassino he wrote his famous Rule, built on prayer and work, *ora et labora*.

Benedictine monasteries preserved faith and learning across Europe. He is patron of Europe.
saint-benedict.prayer_md:
Saint Benedict, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Benedict to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-henry-ii.name: Saint Henry II
saint-henry-ii.life_md:
Henry was Holy Roman Emperor who governed with justice, supported the Church, founded monasteries and the Diocese of Bamberg.

With his wife Saint Cunegunde he was known for his piety.
saint-henry-ii.prayer_md:
Saint Henry II, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Henry II to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-camillus-de-lellis.name: Saint Camillus de Lellis
saint-camillus-de-lellis.life_md:
A soldier and gambler in his youth, Camillus was converted and devoted himself to caring for the sick. He founded the Ministers of the Sick, whose habit bears a red cross.

He urged his brothers to care for each patient as if he were Christ himself.
saint-camillus-de-lellis.prayer_md:
Saint Camillus de Lellis, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Camillus de Lellis to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bonaventure.name: Saint Bonaventure
saint-bonaventure.life_md:
Bonaventure was a Franciscan theologian who taught in Paris alongside Saint Thomas Aquinas. As Minister General he guided the Franciscans wisely, and he wrote the life of Saint Francis.

Called the "Seraphic Doctor", he died during the Council of Lyon.
saint-bonaventure.prayer_md:
Saint Bonaventure, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bonaventure to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-mount-carmel.name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel
our-lady-of-mount-carmel.life_md:
Hermits living on Mount Carmel in the Holy Land formed the Carmelite order under the patronage of the Virgin Mary. Tradition says that in 1251 Mary gave the brown scapular to Saint Simon Stock as a sign of her protection.

Many Catholics wear the scapular as a sign of devotion to Mary.
our-lady-of-mount-carmel.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Mount Carmel, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-apollinaris.name: Saint Apollinaris
saint-apollinaris.life_md: Apollinaris was the first Bishop of Ravenna in Italy. He endured persecution and exile for the faith and is honoured as a martyr.
saint-apollinaris.prayer_md:
Saint Apollinaris, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Apollinaris to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-lawrence-of-brindisi.name: Saint Lawrence of Brindisi
saint-lawrence-of-brindisi.life_md:
Lawrence was a Capuchin friar who knew many languages, including Hebrew, and was a powerful preacher across Europe. He served as a peacemaker and even led troops in prayer before battle.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-lawrence-of-brindisi.prayer_md:
Saint Lawrence of Brindisi, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Lawrence of Brindisi to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-mary-magdalene.name: Saint Mary Magdalene
saint-mary-magdalene.life_md:
Jesus freed Mary of Magdala from seven demons, and she followed him faithfully, standing at the foot of the cross. On Easter morning she was the first to see the risen Lord, who sent her to tell the apostles.

She is called the "Apostle to the Apostles". Pope Francis raised her memorial to a feast.
saint-mary-magdalene.prayer_md:
Saint Mary Magdalene, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Mary Magdalene to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bridget-of-sweden.name: Saint Bridget of Sweden
saint-bridget-of-sweden.life_md:
Bridget was a Swedish noblewoman, wife and mother of eight. After her husband's death she founded the Bridgettine order and moved to Rome, where she urged the popes to reform the Church. Her visions of Christ's Passion were widely read.

She is a patron of Europe.
saint-bridget-of-sweden.prayer_md:
Saint Bridget of Sweden, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bridget of Sweden to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-charbel-makhlouf.name: Saint Charbel Makhlouf
saint-charbel-makhlouf.life_md: Charbel was a Maronite monk in Lebanon who spent his last twenty-three years as a hermit, praying and fasting. Many miracles have been reported at his tomb.
saint-charbel-makhlouf.prayer_md:
Saint Charbel Makhlouf, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Charbel Makhlouf to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-james-the-apostle.name: Saint James the Apostle
saint-james-the-apostle.life_md:
James, son of Zebedee and brother of John, was a fisherman called by Jesus. With Peter and John he witnessed the Transfiguration and the agony in Gethsemane.

He was the first apostle to be martyred, beheaded by King Herod Agrippa. His shrine at Santiago de Compostela in Spain draws pilgrims from around the world.
saint-james-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint James the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint James the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-joachim-and-anne.name: Saints Joachim and Anne
saints-joachim-and-anne.life_md:
According to ancient tradition, Joachim and Anne were the parents of the Virgin Mary and so the grandparents of Jesus. They are honoured for raising Mary in faith.

Pope Francis made the Sunday near this day the World Day for Grandparents and the Elderly.
saints-joachim-and-anne.prayer_md:
Saints Joachim and Anne, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Joachim and Anne to your Church as models of holiness. Through their prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-martha-mary-and-lazarus.name: Saints Martha, Mary and Lazarus
saints-martha-mary-and-lazarus.life_md:
Martha, Mary and their brother Lazarus of Bethany were close friends of Jesus, who welcomed him into their home. Martha served, Mary sat at his feet to listen, and Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead.

Martha professed: "You are the Christ, the Son of God."
saints-martha-mary-and-lazarus.prayer_md:
Saints Martha, Mary and Lazarus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Martha, Mary and Lazarus to your Church as models of holiness. Through their prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-peter-chrysologus.name: Saint Peter Chrysologus
saint-peter-chrysologus.life_md:
Peter was Bishop of Ravenna whose short, powerful sermons earned him the name Chrysologus, "golden word".

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-peter-chrysologus.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Chrysologus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Chrysologus to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-ignatius-of-loyola.name: Saint Ignatius of Loyola
saint-ignatius-of-loyola.life_md:
Ignatius was a Spanish soldier wounded in battle. While recovering, he read lives of Christ and the saints and was converted. He wrote the *Spiritual Exercises* and founded the Society of Jesus, the Jesuits, to serve the Church wherever needed.

His motto: "For the greater glory of God."
saint-ignatius-of-loyola.prayer_md:
Saint Ignatius of Loyola, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Ignatius of Loyola to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-alphonsus-liguori.name: Saint Alphonsus Liguori
saint-alphonsus-liguori.life_md:
Alphonsus left a successful legal career to become a priest. He founded the Redemptorists to preach to the poor, wrote widely on prayer, the Blessed Virgin and moral theology, and became a bishop.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-alphonsus-liguori.prayer_md:
Saint Alphonsus Liguori, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Alphonsus Liguori to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-eusebius-of-vercelli.name: Saint Eusebius of Vercelli
saint-eusebius-of-vercelli.life_md: Eusebius was Bishop of Vercelli in Italy who defended the faith in the divinity of Christ and suffered exile for it. He lived with his clergy in a community of prayer.
saint-eusebius-of-vercelli.prayer_md:
Saint Eusebius of Vercelli, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Eusebius of Vercelli to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-peter-julian-eymard.name: Saint Peter Julian Eymard
saint-peter-julian-eymard.life_md: Peter Julian was a French priest, the "Apostle of the Eucharist", who founded the Congregation of the Blessed Sacrament to promote adoration of Christ in the Eucharist.
saint-peter-julian-eymard.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Julian Eymard, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Julian Eymard to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-vianney.name: Saint John Vianney
saint-john-vianney.life_md:
John Vianney struggled with his studies but became parish priest of the small village of Ars. Through prayer, penance and long hours in the confessional, up to sixteen hours a day, he transformed the village, and pilgrims came from all over France.

He is patron of parish priests.
saint-john-vianney.prayer_md:
Saint John Vianney, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Vianney to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-cajetan.name: Saint Cajetan
saint-cajetan.life_md: Cajetan founded the Theatines, priests dedicated to renewing the clergy and serving the poor. He trusted completely in God's providence.
saint-cajetan.prayer_md:
Saint Cajetan, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Cajetan to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-sixtus-ii-and-companions.name: Saint Sixtus II and Companions
saint-sixtus-ii-and-companions.life_md: Pope Sixtus II was arrested while celebrating the liturgy in the catacombs during the persecution of Valerian and beheaded with four deacons. He is named in the Roman Canon.
saint-sixtus-ii-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saint Sixtus II and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Sixtus II and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-dominic.name: Saint Dominic
saint-dominic.life_md:
Dominic founded the Order of Preachers, the Dominicans, to preach the truth of the Gospel with learning and holiness of life. Tradition links him with spreading the Rosary.

His friars and sisters still preach and teach worldwide.
saint-dominic.prayer_md:
Saint Dominic, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Dominic to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-teresa-benedicta-of-the-cross-edit.name: Saint Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein)
saint-teresa-benedicta-of-the-cross-edit.life_md:
Edith Stein was a Jewish philosopher who found the truth in Christ after reading the life of Saint Teresa of Avila. She became a Carmelite nun.

Arrested by the Nazis, she was killed at Auschwitz in 1942. She is a patron of Europe.
saint-teresa-benedicta-of-the-cross-edit.prayer_md:
Saint Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through her prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-lawrence.name: Saint Lawrence
saint-lawrence.life_md:
Lawrence was a deacon of Rome in charge of caring for the poor. When ordered to hand over the Church's treasures, he gathered the poor and sick and said: "These are the treasures of the Church."

Tradition says he was martyred on a gridiron.
saint-lawrence.prayer_md:
Saint Lawrence, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Lawrence to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-clare-of-assisi.name: Saint Clare of Assisi
saint-clare-of-assisi.life_md:
Inspired by Saint Francis, Clare left her wealthy family to live in poverty and prayer. She founded the Poor Clares. When soldiers attacked Assisi, she held up the Blessed Sacrament and they fled.

She is patron of television because, when sick, she saw Mass on the wall of her room.
saint-clare-of-assisi.prayer_md:
Saint Clare of Assisi, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Clare of Assisi to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-jane-frances-de-chantal.name: Saint Jane Frances de Chantal
saint-jane-frances-de-chantal.life_md: Jane Frances was a widow and mother of four. Guided by Saint Francis de Sales, she founded the Visitation Sisters, welcoming women who could not bear harsh penances.
saint-jane-frances-de-chantal.prayer_md:
Saint Jane Frances de Chantal, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Jane Frances de Chantal to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-pontian-and-hippolytus.name: Saints Pontian and Hippolytus
saints-pontian-and-hippolytus.life_md: Pope Pontian and the priest Hippolytus had been on opposite sides of a dispute in Rome. Both were exiled to the mines of Sardinia, where they were reconciled before dying as martyrs.
saints-pontian-and-hippolytus.prayer_md:
Saints Pontian and Hippolytus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Pontian and Hippolytus to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-maximilian-kolbe.name: Saint Maximilian Kolbe
saint-maximilian-kolbe.life_md:
Maximilian was a Polish Franciscan who spread devotion to Mary Immaculate through publishing. Arrested by the Nazis and sent to Auschwitz, he offered his life in place of a father condemned to die in the starvation bunker.

He was killed by lethal injection on 14 August 1941.
saint-maximilian-kolbe.prayer_md:
Saint Maximilian Kolbe, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

the-assumption-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.name: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-assumption-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.life_md:
At the end of her earthly life, Mary was taken up body and soul into heavenly glory. Pope Pius XII defined this dogma in 1950.

Mary's Assumption is a sign of hope that we too are called to share in the Resurrection of her Son.
the-assumption-of-the-blessed-virgin-mar.prayer_md:
The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-stephen-of-hungary.name: Saint Stephen of Hungary
saint-stephen-of-hungary.life_md: Stephen was the first Christian king of Hungary. He organised the Church in his kingdom, built churches and cared for the poor.
saint-stephen-of-hungary.prayer_md:
Saint Stephen of Hungary, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Stephen of Hungary to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-eudes.name: Saint John Eudes
saint-john-eudes.life_md: John Eudes was a French priest and missionary who founded congregations for the formation of priests and the care of women in need. He promoted devotion to the Hearts of Jesus and Mary.
saint-john-eudes.prayer_md:
Saint John Eudes, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Eudes to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bernard-of-clairvaux.name: Saint Bernard of Clairvaux
saint-bernard-of-clairvaux.life_md:
Bernard joined the Cistercians with thirty companions and became abbot of Clairvaux. A tireless preacher and adviser of popes, he wrote beautifully on the love of God and the Virgin Mary.

He is the "Mellifluous Doctor", a Doctor of the Church.
saint-bernard-of-clairvaux.prayer_md:
Saint Bernard of Clairvaux, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bernard of Clairvaux to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-pius-x.name: Saint Pius X
saint-pius-x.life_md: Giuseppe Sarto, a humble parish priest who became pope, chose the motto "To restore all things in Christ." He encouraged frequent Holy Communion and allowed children to receive it from the age of reason.
saint-pius-x.prayer_md:
Saint Pius X, pray for us.
