Almighty God, you gave Saint Pius X to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-queenship-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.name: The Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-queenship-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.life_md: A week after the Assumption, the Church honours Mary as Queen of heaven and earth. Her queenship is one of loving service, sharing in the kingship of her Son.
the-queenship-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.prayer_md:
The Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-rose-of-lima.name: Saint Rose of Lima
saint-rose-of-lima.life_md: Rose was a Dominican tertiary in Lima who lived a life of prayer and penance in a small hut in her family's garden, caring for the sick and poor. She was the first saint of the Americas.
saint-rose-of-lima.prayer_md:
Saint Rose of Lima, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Rose of Lima to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bartholomew-the-apostle.name: Saint Bartholomew the Apostle
saint-bartholomew-the-apostle.life_md: Bartholomew is usually identified with Nathanael, whom Jesus called "an Israelite in whom there is no guile." Tradition says he preached in India and Armenia, where he was martyred.
saint-bartholomew-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint Bartholomew the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bartholomew the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-joseph-calasanz.name: Saint Joseph Calasanz
saint-joseph-calasanz.life_md: Joseph opened the first free public school in Europe in Rome and founded the Piarists to educate poor children.
saint-joseph-calasanz.prayer_md:
Saint Joseph Calasanz, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Joseph Calasanz to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-louis-of-france.name: Saint Louis of France
saint-louis-of-france.life_md: Louis IX, King of France, was a just ruler, devoted husband and father of eleven, and generous to the poor. He died of disease near Tunis while on crusade.
saint-louis-of-france.prayer_md:
Saint Louis of France, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Louis of France to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-monica.name: Saint Monica
saint-monica.life_md:
Monica was a Christian wife and mother in North Africa who prayed for years for the conversion of her husband and her son Augustine. Her prayers and tears were answered when Augustine was baptised.

She is a patron of mothers.
saint-monica.prayer_md:
Saint Monica, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Monica to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-augustine-of-hippo.name: Saint Augustine of Hippo
saint-augustine-of-hippo.life_md:
Augustine, born in today's Algeria, searched for truth through pleasure and philosophy until he was converted in Milan. He became Bishop of Hippo and one of the greatest teachers of the Church. His *Confessions* begin: "You have made us for yourself, O Lord, and our hearts are restless until they rest in you."

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-augustine-of-hippo.prayer_md:
Saint Augustine of Hippo, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Augustine of Hippo to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-passion-of-saint-john-the-baptist.name: The Passion of Saint John the Baptist
the-passion-of-saint-john-the-baptist.life_md:
John the Baptist rebuked King Herod for taking his brother's wife. Herodias held a grudge, and at a banquet her daughter asked for John's head on a platter.

John died a martyr for truth.
the-passion-of-saint-john-the-baptist.prayer_md:
The Passion of Saint John the Baptist, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Passion of Saint John the Baptist to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-gregory-the-great.name: Saint Gregory the Great
saint-gregory-the-great.life_md:
Gregory gave up a high government post to become a monk and was elected pope in a time of plague and war. He fed the poor, sent missionaries to England and wrote on the pastoral care of souls. Gregorian chant bears his name.

He called himself "servant of the servants of God". He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-gregory-the-great.prayer_md:
Saint Gregory the Great, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Gregory the Great to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-nativity-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.name: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-nativity-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.life_md: Nine months after the Immaculate Conception, the Church celebrates the birth of Mary, the dawn of salvation. Her birth announced the coming of Christ, the Light of the world.
the-nativity-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.prayer_md:
The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-peter-claver.name: Saint Peter Claver
saint-peter-claver.life_md:
Peter Claver was a Spanish Jesuit who served the enslaved Africans brought to Cartagena in Colombia. For forty years he met the slave ships, bringing food, medicine and the love of Christ, and baptised many.

He called himself "the slave of the slaves forever".
saint-peter-claver.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Claver, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Claver to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-most-holy-name-of-mary.name: The Most Holy Name of Mary
the-most-holy-name-of-mary.life_md: The Church honours the holy name of Mary, Mother of God, to whom Christians have always turned in prayer. The feast spread after the victory at Vienna in 1683.
the-most-holy-name-of-mary.prayer_md:
The Most Holy Name of Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-john-chrysostom.name: Saint John Chrysostom
saint-john-chrysostom.life_md:
John was a priest of Antioch whose eloquence earned him the name Chrysostom, "golden mouth". As Archbishop of Constantinople he challenged the rich and powerful and was exiled. His last words were: "Glory to God for all things."

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-john-chrysostom.prayer_md:
Saint John Chrysostom, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Chrysostom to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-sorrows.name: Our Lady of Sorrows
our-lady-of-sorrows.life_md:
The day after the Exaltation of the Holy Cross, the Church remembers Mary standing by the cross of her Son. Simeon had foretold that a sword would pierce her soul.

She shares in our sufferings and teaches us faithful love.
our-lady-of-sorrows.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Sorrows, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saints-cornelius-and-cyprian.name: Saints Cornelius and Cyprian
saints-cornelius-and-cyprian.life_md: Pope Cornelius and Cyprian, Bishop of Carthage in North Africa, stood together for the unity of the Church and mercy toward those who had lapsed during persecution. Both died as martyrs. They are named in the Roman Canon.
saints-cornelius-and-cyprian.prayer_md:
Saints Cornelius and Cyprian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Cornelius and Cyprian to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-hildegard-of-bingen.name: Saint Hildegard of Bingen
saint-hildegard-of-bingen.life_md:
Hildegard was a Benedictine abbess, mystic, composer and writer on medicine and nature. She advised popes and emperors.

Pope Benedict XVI named her a Doctor of the Church in 2012.
saint-hildegard-of-bingen.prayer_md:
Saint Hildegard of Bingen, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Hildegard of Bingen to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through her prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-robert-bellarmine.name: Saint Robert Bellarmine
saint-robert-bellarmine.life_md:
Robert Bellarmine was a Jesuit theologian and cardinal who explained and defended the Catholic faith after the Reformation and wrote catechisms for children.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-robert-bellarmine.prayer_md:
Saint Robert Bellarmine, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Robert Bellarmine to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-januarius.name: Saint Januarius
saint-januarius.life_md: Januarius was Bishop of Benevento who was beheaded during the persecution of Diocletian. In Naples a vial of his blood is venerated.
saint-januarius.prayer_md:
Saint Januarius, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Januarius to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-andrew-kim-taegon-paul-chong-hasa.name: Saints Andrew Kim Taegon, Paul Chong Hasang and Companions
saints-andrew-kim-taegon-paul-chong-hasa.life_md: The Church in Korea was begun by lay people who discovered the faith through books. Andrew Kim Taegon was the first Korean priest; Paul Chong Hasang was a lay leader. They and 101 companions were martyred in the 19th century.
saints-andrew-kim-taegon-paul-chong-hasa.prayer_md:
Saints Andrew Kim Taegon, Paul Chong Hasang and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Andrew Kim Taegon, Paul Chong Hasang and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-matthew-apostle-and-evangelist.name: Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist
saint-matthew-apostle-and-evangelist.life_md: Matthew was a tax collector sitting at his booth when Jesus said, "Follow me." He rose and followed, and later wrote the Gospel that bears his name, showing Jesus as the fulfilment of God's promises.
saint-matthew-apostle-and-evangelist.prayer_md:
Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-pio-of-pietrelcina-padre-pio.name: Saint Pio of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio)
saint-pio-of-pietrelcina-padre-pio.life_md:
Padre Pio was a Capuchin friar who bore the wounds of Christ, the stigmata, for fifty years. Thousands came to him for confession and spiritual guidance. He founded a great hospital, the House for the Relief of Suffering.

His advice: "Pray, hope and don't worry."
saint-pio-of-pietrelcina-padre-pio.prayer_md:
Saint Pio of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio), pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Pio of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio) to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-cosmas-and-damian.name: Saints Cosmas and Damian
saints-cosmas-and-damian.life_md: Cosmas and Damian were twin brothers and doctors who treated the sick without charge. They were martyred under Diocletian and are named in the Roman Canon.
saints-cosmas-and-damian.prayer_md:
Saints Cosmas and Damian, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Cosmas and Damian to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-vincent-de-paul.name: Saint Vincent de Paul
saint-vincent-de-paul.life_md:
Vincent de Paul dedicated his life to the poor. He founded the Congregation of the Mission and, with Saint Louise de Marillac, the Daughters of Charity.

The Society of Saint Vincent de Paul carries on his work in parishes around the world.
saint-vincent-de-paul.prayer_md:
Saint Vincent de Paul, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Vincent de Paul to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-wenceslaus.name: Saint Wenceslaus
saint-wenceslaus.life_md: Wenceslaus was Duke of Bohemia, known for his faith and charity to the poor. He was murdered by his brother on the way to Mass.
saint-wenceslaus.prayer_md:
Saint Wenceslaus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Wenceslaus to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-lorenzo-ruiz-and-companions.name: Saint Lorenzo Ruiz and Companions
saint-lorenzo-ruiz-and-companions.life_md: Lorenzo Ruiz was a Filipino husband and father who joined Dominican missionaries going to Japan. Arrested, he refused to deny Christ and was martyred in Nagasaki with fifteen companions.
saint-lorenzo-ruiz-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saint Lorenzo Ruiz and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Lorenzo Ruiz and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-michael-gabriel-and-raphael-archa.name: Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels
saints-michael-gabriel-and-raphael-archa.life_md:
Michael ("Who is like God?") defends God's people against evil; Gabriel ("strength of God") announced to Mary that she would bear the Son of God; Raphael ("God heals") guided Tobias and healed his father.

The archangels remind us of God's care through his angels.
saints-michael-gabriel-and-raphael-archa.prayer_md:
Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-jerome.name: Saint Jerome
saint-jerome.life_md:
Jerome was a scholar who translated the Bible into Latin, the Vulgate, used by the Church for centuries. He lived as a monk in Bethlehem. He said: "Ignorance of Scripture is ignorance of Christ."

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-jerome.prayer_md:
Saint Jerome, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Jerome to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-therese-of-the-child-jesus.name: Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus
saint-therese-of-the-child-jesus.life_md:
Thérèse entered the Carmel of Lisieux at fifteen and died of tuberculosis at twenty-four. Her "little way" teaches that holiness lies in doing small things with great love and trusting God like a child. Her autobiography, *Story of a Soul*, has touched millions.

Though she never left her convent, she is patron of missions and a Doctor of the Church.
saint-therese-of-the-child-jesus.prayer_md:
Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through her prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-holy-guardian-angels.name: The Holy Guardian Angels
the-holy-guardian-angels.life_md:
The Church teaches that each person has a guardian angel to protect and guide them. Jesus said of little ones: "Their angels in heaven always behold the face of my Father."

We thank God for this gift and ask our angels' help.
the-holy-guardian-angels.prayer_md:
The Holy Guardian Angels, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-francis-of-assisi.name: Saint Francis of Assisi
saint-francis-of-assisi.life_md:
Francis, son of a rich merchant, heard Christ say from a crucifix, "Rebuild my Church." He gave up everything to live in poverty, joy and love for all creation. He founded the Franciscans, and two years before his death he received the stigmata.

His *Canticle of the Creatures* praises God for "Brother Sun" and "Sister Moon".
saint-francis-of-assisi.prayer_md:
Saint Francis of Assisi, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Francis of Assisi to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-faustina-kowalska.name: Saint Faustina Kowalska
saint-faustina-kowalska.life_md: Faustina was a Polish sister who received messages from Jesus about his Divine Mercy. Her diary gave the Church the Divine Mercy image, the Chaplet and Divine Mercy Sunday. Jesus asked that the image bear the words "Jesus, I trust in you."
saint-faustina-kowalska.prayer_md:
Saint Faustina Kowalska, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Faustina Kowalska to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-bruno.name: Saint Bruno
saint-bruno.life_md: Bruno was a respected teacher who left the world to found the Carthusians in the mountains of the Chartreuse, a life of silence, solitude and prayer.
saint-bruno.prayer_md:
Saint Bruno, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Bruno to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-the-rosary.name: Our Lady of the Rosary
our-lady-of-the-rosary.life_md:
Pope Pius V set this feast after the victory at Lepanto in 1571, which was credited to Christians praying the Rosary. The Rosary leads us to meditate on the life of Christ with Mary.

October is dedicated to the Holy Rosary.
our-lady-of-the-rosary.prayer_md:
Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-denis-and-companions.name: Saint Denis and Companions
saint-denis-and-companions.life_md: Denis was a missionary bishop sent to Gaul who became the first Bishop of Paris. He was beheaded with two companions on the hill now called Montmartre.
saint-denis-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saint Denis and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Denis and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-leonardi.name: Saint John Leonardi
saint-john-leonardi.life_md: John Leonardi, a pharmacist who became a priest, founded a congregation to teach the faith and helped start the college that trains missionaries for the Church.
saint-john-leonardi.prayer_md:
Saint John Leonardi, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Leonardi to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-xxiii.name: Saint John XXIII
saint-john-xxiii.life_md: Angelo Roncalli, a farmer's son, served as a papal diplomat before becoming pope at seventy-six. Known as "Good Pope John" for his warmth, he opened the Second Vatican Council on 11 October 1962 to renew the Church.
saint-john-xxiii.prayer_md:
Saint John XXIII, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John XXIII to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-callistus-i.name: Saint Callistus I
saint-callistus-i.life_md: Callistus was a former slave who was put in charge of a Christian cemetery in Rome, now named after him, and later became pope. He showed mercy to repentant sinners and died a martyr.
saint-callistus-i.prayer_md:
Saint Callistus I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Callistus I to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-teresa-of-avila.name: Saint Teresa of Avila
saint-teresa-of-avila.life_md:
Teresa was a Carmelite nun who reformed her order, founding many convents of strict prayer and poverty with Saint John of the Cross. Her books, such as *The Interior Castle*, are classics of prayer. "Let nothing disturb you... God alone suffices."

She was the first woman named a Doctor of the Church.
saint-teresa-of-avila.prayer_md:
Saint Teresa of Avila, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Teresa of Avila to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through her prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-hedwig.name: Saint Hedwig
saint-hedwig.life_md: Hedwig was Duchess of Silesia, wife and mother, who founded hospitals and monasteries and served the poor. After her husband died she lived in a convent.
saint-hedwig.prayer_md:
Saint Hedwig, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Hedwig to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-margaret-mary-alacoque.name: Saint Margaret Mary Alacoque
saint-margaret-mary-alacoque.life_md: Margaret Mary was a Visitation nun to whom Jesus revealed his Sacred Heart, burning with love for humanity. She spread the devotion of the First Fridays and the feast of the Sacred Heart.
saint-margaret-mary-alacoque.prayer_md:
Saint Margaret Mary Alacoque, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-ignatius-of-antioch.name: Saint Ignatius of Antioch
saint-ignatius-of-antioch.life_md: Ignatius was Bishop of Antioch, perhaps a disciple of Saint John. Taken to Rome to be thrown to the lions, he wrote seven letters to the churches on unity and the Eucharist, calling himself "God's wheat, ground by the teeth of beasts". He was the first to call the Church "Catholic".
saint-ignatius-of-antioch.prayer_md:
Saint Ignatius of Antioch, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Ignatius of Antioch to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-luke-the-evangelist.name: Saint Luke the Evangelist
saint-luke-the-evangelist.life_md: Luke was a physician and companion of Saint Paul. He wrote the Gospel that shows Jesus' mercy for the poor and sinners, and the Acts of the Apostles. His Gospel gives us the stories of the Annunciation, the Nativity and the Prodigal Son.
saint-luke-the-evangelist.prayer_md:
Saint Luke the Evangelist, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-paul-of-the-cross.name: Saint Paul of the Cross
saint-paul-of-the-cross.life_md: Paul founded the Passionists, who preach the love of God shown in the Passion of Jesus.
saint-paul-of-the-cross.prayer_md:
Saint Paul of the Cross, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Paul of the Cross to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-john-de-brebeuf-isaac-jogues-and-.name: Saints John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions
saints-john-de-brebeuf-isaac-jogues-and-.life_md: Jean de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and six companions were French Jesuit missionaries and lay helpers who brought the Gospel to the native peoples of North America and were martyred there.
saints-john-de-brebeuf-isaac-jogues-and-.prayer_md:
Saints John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-paul-ii.name: Saint John Paul II
saint-john-paul-ii.life_md:
Karol Wojtyła, actor, priest and Archbishop of Kraków, became pope in 1978. "Be not afraid!" he told the world. He travelled to over 120 countries, including many in Africa, Asia and Latin America. He began World Youth Day and taught tirelessly on human dignity and the family.

He was canonised in 2014.
saint-john-paul-ii.prayer_md:
Saint John Paul II, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Paul II to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-of-capistrano.name: Saint John of Capistrano
saint-john-of-capistrano.life_md: John was a lawyer and governor who became a Franciscan preacher across Europe. At seventy he helped lead the defence of Belgrade in 1456.
saint-john-of-capistrano.prayer_md:
Saint John of Capistrano, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John of Capistrano to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-anthony-mary-claret.name: Saint Anthony Mary Claret
saint-anthony-mary-claret.life_md: Anthony Mary Claret was a Spanish missionary who preached widely, founded the Claretians and served as Archbishop of Santiago in Cuba. He used the printing press to spread the faith.
saint-anthony-mary-claret.prayer_md:
Saint Anthony Mary Claret, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saints-simon-and-jude-apostles.name: Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles
saints-simon-and-jude-apostles.life_md: Simon "the Zealot" and Jude, also called Thaddeus, were among the Twelve. Tradition says they preached together and were martyred. Saint Jude is invoked in desperate causes.
saints-simon-and-jude-apostles.prayer_md:
Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles to your Church as apostles of the Good News. Through their prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

all-saints.name: All Saints
all-saints.life_md:
Today we celebrate all the saints in heaven, known and unknown, the "great multitude which no one could count". They are our family and our friends, who pray for us.

The feast reminds us that we too are called to holiness.
all-saints.prayer_md:
All you holy men and women, saints of God, pray for us.

Almighty ever-living God, by whose gift we celebrate the merits of all the Saints, bestow on us through their prayers the abundance of your mercy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-martin-de-porres.name: Saint Martin de Porres
saint-martin-de-porres.life_md:
Martin was born in Lima to a Spanish father and a freed African mother and suffered prejudice for his mixed race. As a Dominican brother he cared for the sick and poor of every race, and even animals, with great humility.

He is patron of racial harmony.
saint-martin-de-porres.prayer_md:
Saint Martin de Porres, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Martin de Porres to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-charles-borromeo.name: Saint Charles Borromeo
saint-charles-borromeo.life_md: Charles was Archbishop of Milan who put the reforms of the Council of Trent into practice, founding seminaries and teaching the faith. During the plague he stayed with his people, caring for the sick.
saint-charles-borromeo.prayer_md:
Saint Charles Borromeo, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Charles Borromeo to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-leo-the-great.name: Saint Leo the Great
saint-leo-the-great.life_md:
Pope Leo I taught clearly that Christ is one Person, truly God and truly man, a teaching confirmed by the Council of Chalcedon. He persuaded Attila the Hun not to attack Rome.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-leo-the-great.prayer_md:
Saint Leo the Great, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Leo the Great to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-martin-of-tours.name: Saint Martin of Tours
saint-martin-of-tours.life_md: As a young Roman soldier, Martin cut his cloak in half to share it with a freezing beggar; that night he dreamed of Christ wearing it. He became a monk and Bishop of Tours, loved for his care of the poor.
saint-martin-of-tours.prayer_md:
Saint Martin of Tours, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Martin of Tours to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-josaphat.name: Saint Josaphat
saint-josaphat.life_md: Josaphat was a Ukrainian archbishop of the Byzantine rite who worked for unity between Eastern Christians and Rome. He was killed by opponents of that unity.
saint-josaphat.prayer_md:
Saint Josaphat, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Josaphat to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-albert-the-great.name: Saint Albert the Great
saint-albert-the-great.life_md:
Albert was a Dominican scholar who studied nature, science and philosophy and taught Saint Thomas Aquinas. He served briefly as a bishop.

He is a Doctor of the Church and patron of scientists.
saint-albert-the-great.prayer_md:
Saint Albert the Great, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Albert the Great to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-gertrude-the-great.name: Saint Gertrude the Great
saint-gertrude-the-great.life_md: Gertrude was a nun of Helfta in Germany whose mystical writings speak of the love of the Sacred Heart of Jesus. She is one of the few women saints called "the Great".
saint-gertrude-the-great.prayer_md:
Saint Gertrude the Great, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Gertrude the Great to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-margaret-of-scotland.name: Saint Margaret of Scotland
saint-margaret-of-scotland.life_md: Margaret was Queen of Scotland, wife and mother of eight. She used her position to serve the poor, encourage learning and renew the Church, and every day fed orphans and the needy.
saint-margaret-of-scotland.prayer_md:
Saint Margaret of Scotland, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Margaret of Scotland to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-elizabeth-of-hungary.name: Saint Elizabeth of Hungary
saint-elizabeth-of-hungary.life_md: Elizabeth, a princess, married young and was widowed at twenty. She gave her wealth to the poor, built a hospital and served the sick herself as a Franciscan tertiary. She died at twenty-four.
saint-elizabeth-of-hungary.prayer_md:
Saint Elizabeth of Hungary, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Elizabeth of Hungary to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-presentation-of-the-blessed-virgin-m.name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-presentation-of-the-blessed-virgin-m.life_md: According to ancient tradition, Mary was presented in the Temple as a child and dedicated to God by her parents, Joachim and Anne. The feast celebrates her total gift of herself to the Lord.
the-presentation-of-the-blessed-virgin-m.prayer_md:
The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-cecilia.name: Saint Cecilia
saint-cecilia.life_md: Cecilia was a Roman martyr who, it is said, sang to God in her heart on her wedding day. She is named in the Roman Canon and is patron of music and musicians.
saint-cecilia.prayer_md:
Saint Cecilia, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Cecilia to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-clement-i.name: Saint Clement I
saint-clement-i.life_md: Clement was one of the first popes after Saint Peter. His letter to the Church in Corinth, urging peace and unity, is one of the earliest Christian writings after the New Testament.
saint-clement-i.prayer_md:
Saint Clement I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Clement I to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-columban.name: Saint Columban
saint-columban.life_md: Columban was an Irish monk who founded monasteries in France, Switzerland and Italy, renewing faith across Europe.
saint-columban.prayer_md:
Saint Columban, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Columban to your Church as a model of prayer and holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to seek you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saints-andrew-dung-lac-and-companions.name: Saints Andrew Dung-Lac and Companions
saints-andrew-dung-lac-and-companions.life_md: Andrew Dung-Lac was a Vietnamese priest martyred in 1839. He is honoured with 116 companions, priests, religious and lay people, who died for Christ in Vietnam.
saints-andrew-dung-lac-and-companions.prayer_md:
Saints Andrew Dung-Lac and Companions, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saints Andrew Dung-Lac and Companions to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-catherine-of-alexandria.name: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
saint-catherine-of-alexandria.life_md: Catherine was a learned young woman of Alexandria in Egypt who, according to tradition, defended the faith before philosophers and converted many. She was martyred, condemned to the wheel and then beheaded.
saint-catherine-of-alexandria.prayer_md:
Saint Catherine of Alexandria, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Catherine of Alexandria to your Church as a model of holiness. Through her prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-andrew-the-apostle.name: Saint Andrew the Apostle
saint-andrew-the-apostle.life_md:
Andrew, a fisherman and disciple of John the Baptist, was the first to follow Jesus. He brought his brother Simon Peter to the Lord, saying: "We have found the Messiah."

Tradition says he was crucified on an X-shaped cross in Greece.
saint-andrew-the-apostle.prayer_md:
Saint Andrew the Apostle, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Andrew the Apostle to your Church as an apostle of the Good News. Through his prayers and example, help us to believe the Gospel and to share it with joy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-francis-xavier.name: Saint Francis Xavier
saint-francis-xavier.life_md:
Francis Xavier was one of the first Jesuits. He carried the Gospel to India, Southeast Asia and Japan, baptising tens of thousands, and died hoping to enter China.

He is patron of missions with Saint Thérèse.
saint-francis-xavier.prayer_md:
Saint Francis Xavier, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Francis Xavier to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-damascene.name: Saint John Damascene
saint-john-damascene.life_md:
John of Damascus was a monk near Jerusalem who defended the veneration of holy images and wrote a summary of the faith.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-john-damascene.prayer_md:
Saint John Damascene, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John Damascene to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-nicholas.name: Saint Nicholas
saint-nicholas.life_md:
Nicholas was Bishop of Myra in today's Turkey, famous for his secret gifts to the poor. Tradition tells that he gave gold so three poor girls could marry.

He inspired the figure of Santa Claus.
saint-nicholas.prayer_md:
Saint Nicholas, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Nicholas to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-ambrose.name: Saint Ambrose
saint-ambrose.life_md:
Ambrose was governor of Milan, not yet baptised, when the people acclaimed him bishop. He became a great pastor and teacher, wrote hymns and baptised Saint Augustine.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-ambrose.prayer_md:
Saint Ambrose, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Ambrose to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-immaculate-conception-of-the-blessed.name: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
the-immaculate-conception-of-the-blessed.life_md:
From the first moment of her conception, Mary was preserved free from original sin by the merits of her Son. Pope Pius IX defined this dogma in 1854; at Lourdes in 1858 Mary named herself "the Immaculate Conception".

Under this title Mary is honoured as patroness by many nations around the world.
the-immaculate-conception-of-the-blessed.prayer_md:
The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-juan-diego.name: Saint Juan Diego
saint-juan-diego.life_md:
Juan Diego was an indigenous man of Mexico to whom the Virgin Mary appeared at Tepeyac in 1531. Her image miraculously appeared on his cloak, the *tilma*.

He was the first indigenous saint of the Americas.
saint-juan-diego.prayer_md:
Saint Juan Diego, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Juan Diego to your Church as a model of holiness. Through his prayers and example, help us to follow Christ faithfully in our daily lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-loreto.name: Our Lady of Loreto
our-lady-of-loreto.life_md:
At Loreto in Italy, the Holy House, venerated as the home of the Holy Family in Nazareth, has drawn pilgrims for centuries. Pope Francis added this memorial in 2019.

Our Lady of Loreto is patron of air travellers.
our-lady-of-loreto.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Loreto, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-damasus-i.name: Saint Damasus I
saint-damasus-i.life_md: Pope Damasus encouraged Saint Jerome to translate the Bible into Latin and honoured the martyrs' tombs with inscriptions.
saint-damasus-i.prayer_md:
Saint Damasus I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Damasus I to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

our-lady-of-guadalupe.name: Our Lady of Guadalupe
our-lady-of-guadalupe.life_md:
In 1531 Mary appeared to Saint Juan Diego near Mexico City as a young indigenous woman. Her image on his cloak led millions to faith.

She is patron of the Americas and of the unborn.
our-lady-of-guadalupe.prayer_md:
Our Lady of Guadalupe, pray for us.

Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

saint-lucy.name: Saint Lucy
saint-lucy.life_md: Lucy was a young Christian woman of Sicily who gave her dowry to the poor and was martyred during the persecution of Diocletian. Her name means "light". She is named in the Roman Canon.
saint-lucy.prayer_md:
Saint Lucy, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Lucy to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through her prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-of-the-cross.name: Saint John of the Cross
saint-john-of-the-cross.life_md:
John helped Saint Teresa of Avila reform the Carmelites and was imprisoned by his own brothers for it. In prison he wrote poems of deep love for God. His *Dark Night of the Soul* guides souls through trials toward union with God.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-john-of-the-cross.prayer_md:
Saint John of the Cross, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John of the Cross to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-peter-canisius.name: Saint Peter Canisius
saint-peter-canisius.life_md:
Peter Canisius was a Dutch Jesuit who renewed the Catholic faith in Germany after the Reformation. His catechisms were used for centuries.

He is a Doctor of the Church.
saint-peter-canisius.prayer_md:
Saint Peter Canisius, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Peter Canisius to your Church as a teacher of the true faith. Through his prayers and example, help us to know you more deeply and to live by your truth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-of-kanty.name: Saint John of Kanty
saint-john-of-kanty.life_md: John of Kanty was a professor at the University of Kraków, known for his learning and his generosity to poor students.
saint-john-of-kanty.prayer_md:
Saint John of Kanty, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint John of Kanty to your Church as a faithful servant of the Gospel. Through his prayers and example, help us to serve you and our neighbour with generous hearts. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-stephen-the-first-martyr.name: Saint Stephen, the First Martyr
saint-stephen-the-first-martyr.life_md:
Stephen was one of the first seven deacons, "full of faith and the Holy Spirit". Stoned to death in Jerusalem, he prayed, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them."

Saul, the future Saint Paul, watched his death.
saint-stephen-the-first-martyr.prayer_md:
Saint Stephen, the First Martyr, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Stephen, the First Martyr to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-john-apostle-and-evangelist.name: Saint John, Apostle and Evangelist
saint-john-apostle-and-evangelist.life_md:
John, the "disciple whom Jesus loved", stood at the cross and was given Mary as his mother. He wrote the fourth Gospel, three letters and, by tradition, the Book of Revelation. "God is love."

He is said to have died in old age at Ephesus.
saint-john-apostle-and-evangelist.prayer_md:
Saint John, Apostle and Evangelist, pray for us.

Lord God, in your loving providence you send your holy angels to watch over us. Grant that we may be defended by their protection and rejoice one day in their company. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-holy-innocents.name: The Holy Innocents
the-holy-innocents.life_md:
King Herod, fearing the newborn King, ordered the killing of all boys under two in Bethlehem. The Church honours these children as martyrs who died in place of Christ.

We pray for all children who suffer violence.
the-holy-innocents.prayer_md:
The Holy Innocents, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave The Holy Innocents to your Church as faithful witnesses to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through their prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-thomas-becket.name: Saint Thomas Becket
saint-thomas-becket.life_md: Thomas was Chancellor of England and friend of King Henry II. As Archbishop of Canterbury he defended the freedom of the Church against the king and was murdered in his cathedral.
saint-thomas-becket.prayer_md:
Saint Thomas Becket, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Thomas Becket to your Church as a faithful witness to Christ, even to the shedding of blood. Through his prayers and example, help us to stand firm in faith and to love you above all things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

saint-sylvester-i.name: Saint Sylvester I
saint-sylvester-i.life_md: Sylvester was pope when Emperor Constantine ended the persecution of Christians. During his time the Council of Nicaea (325) proclaimed the faith in Christ, true God, and great churches like the Lateran Basilica were built.
saint-sylvester-i.prayer_md:
Saint Sylvester I, pray for us.

Almighty God, you gave Saint Sylvester I to your Church as a shepherd of your people. Through his prayers and example, help us to love your Church and to serve one another. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-most-holy-name-of-jesus.name: The Most Holy Name of Jesus
the-most-holy-name-of-jesus.life_md:
The name Jesus means "God saves". The angel gave it to Mary and Joseph before his birth, and at his name, Saint Paul writes, "every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth".

The Church honours the holy name by which we are saved, and invites us to call on it with love and reverence.
the-most-holy-name-of-jesus.prayer_md: Lord Jesus Christ, at your holy name every knee shall bow. May your name be always on our lips and in our hearts, so that we may live for you and rest in you for ever. Amen.

the-presentation-of-the-lord.name: The Presentation of the Lord
the-presentation-of-the-lord.life_md:
Forty days after Christmas, Mary and Joseph brought the infant Jesus to the Temple in Jerusalem to present him to the Lord. The aged Simeon took him in his arms and blessed God: "My eyes have seen your salvation, a light for revelation to the Gentiles." The prophetess Anna also spoke of him to all who awaited redemption.

Candles are blessed on this day, which is also the World Day for Consecrated Life.
the-presentation-of-the-lord.prayer_md: Lord God, as your Son was presented in the Temple, grant that we too may be presented to you with clean hearts. May Christ, the Light of the nations, shine in our lives. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-annunciation-of-the-lord.name: The Annunciation of the Lord
the-annunciation-of-the-lord.life_md:
The angel Gabriel was sent to Mary in Nazareth to announce that she would conceive and bear a son, the Son of the Most High. Mary answered: "Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to your word." At that moment the Word became flesh.

Nine months before Christmas, the Church celebrates the beginning of our salvation.
the-annunciation-of-the-lord.prayer_md: Lord God, by the angel's message your Word took flesh in the womb of the Virgin Mary. As we believe that he is truly God and truly man, may we, like Mary, say "yes" to your will. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-dedication-of-the-basilica-of-saint-.name: The Dedication of the Basilica of Saint Mary Major
the-dedication-of-the-basilica-of-saint-.life_md:
After the Council of Ephesus proclaimed Mary the Mother of God in 431, Pope Sixtus III built this great basilica in Rome in her honour. It is the oldest church in the West dedicated to Our Lady.

A tradition tells of snow falling on this hill in the heat of August to show where the church should be built.
the-dedication-of-the-basilica-of-saint-.prayer_md: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us. Lord God, through the prayers of the Virgin Mary, help us to grow in faith and love, and bring us safely to the glory of heaven. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-transfiguration-of-the-lord.name: The Transfiguration of the Lord
the-transfiguration-of-the-lord.life_md:
Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain, and there he was transfigured before them: his face shone like the sun and his clothes became white as light. Moses and Elijah appeared with him, and a voice from the cloud said: "This is my beloved Son; listen to him."

The Transfiguration gave the disciples a glimpse of glory to strengthen them before the Cross.
the-transfiguration-of-the-lord.prayer_md: Lord God, in the glorious Transfiguration of your Son you showed us his glory. Help us to listen to him, so that we may share his glory in heaven. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-exaltation-of-the-holy-cross.name: The Exaltation of the Holy Cross
the-exaltation-of-the-holy-cross.life_md:
The Church lifts up the Cross of Christ, the tree of life on which he died for our salvation. The feast recalls the finding of the True Cross in Jerusalem by Saint Helena and the dedication of the Basilica of the Holy Sepulchre in 335.

"We adore you, O Christ, and we bless you, because by your holy Cross you have redeemed the world."
the-exaltation-of-the-holy-cross.prayer_md: We adore you, O Christ, and we bless you, because by your holy Cross you have redeemed the world. Lord, may we who have known the mystery of the Cross on earth enjoy its fruits in heaven. Amen.

the-commemoration-of-all-the-faithful-de.name: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed (All Souls)
the-commemoration-of-all-the-faithful-de.life_md:
The day after All Saints, the Church prays for all the faithful departed who are being purified before entering the joy of heaven. Praying for the dead is an ancient Christian practice of love.

Priests may celebrate three Masses today, and many families visit graves and offer Masses for their loved ones.
the-commemoration-of-all-the-faithful-de.prayer_md: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. May they rest in peace. May their souls and the souls of all the faithful departed, through the mercy of God, rest in peace. Amen.

the-dedication-of-the-lateran-basilica.name: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica
the-dedication-of-the-lateran-basilica.life_md:
The Basilica of Saint John Lateran is the cathedral of Rome, the Pope's own cathedral, and is called "the mother and head of all the churches of the city and of the world". It was dedicated around 324, soon after the Church gained freedom.

The feast celebrates our unity with the Pope, and reminds us that we ourselves are God's temple, built of living stones.
the-dedication-of-the-lateran-basilica.prayer_md: Lord God, from living and chosen stones you build an eternal dwelling for your glory. Increase in your Church the spirit of grace, so that your faithful people may grow into the heavenly Jerusalem. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-dedication-of-the-basilicas-of-saint.name: The Dedication of the Basilicas of Saints Peter and Paul
the-dedication-of-the-basilicas-of-saint.life_md:
Today the Church remembers the dedication of the two great basilicas of Rome built over the tombs of the Apostles: Saint Peter's on the Vatican Hill and Saint Paul's Outside the Walls on the road to Ostia. Both were first built in the time of Emperor Constantine in the fourth century.

The feast honours the two Apostles whose preaching and martyrdom founded the Church of Rome, and invites us to stand firm in the faith they handed on.
the-dedication-of-the-basilicas-of-saint.prayer_md: Saints Peter and Paul, pray for us. Lord God, defend your Church through the protection of the holy Apostles, so that, as she received the faith through them, she may grow in grace until the end of time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

the-nativity-of-the-lord-christmas.name: The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas)
the-nativity-of-the-lord-christmas.life_md:
Today the Word became flesh and dwelt among us. In Bethlehem the Son of God was born of the Virgin Mary and laid in a manger, and the angels sang: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to people of good will."

Christmas celebrates God's love made visible: Emmanuel, God with us.
the-nativity-of-the-lord-christmas.prayer_md: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to people of good will. Lord God, as we rejoice in the birth of your Son, may we who welcome him as Redeemer share in his divine life. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
